notes: Completion is called directly even at morph=0, so a harness branch cannot hide the renderer handoff.
Each contact sheet: columns 2D, 0, 1e-8, 0.001, 0.01; rows empty board and eight stones with a recent last-move marker.
One reused context runs forward, visits morph=1, returns through each near-zero progress, then renders 2D; all reverse images must equal forward images.
Mean RGB error uses raw 0–255 channels. Regions separately sample unoccupied grid points, cell interiors and the last-move stone.
